title: A University of Florida Professor Stopped Fighting AI in His Classroom: A Peer-Reviewed Study Followed
facebook: A professor tried to ban AI in his classroom — then did a research study and changed his mind. The finding? Using AI the right way actually helps you learn more, not less.
